## Vocabulary

Terms this pack was harvested with, grouped by their relation to the concept; counts are units matched / sources. Zero-hit terms are listed under Coverage. On every unit line, `keywords:` names the terms that matched.

- **self**: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design (28/10)

## Structure and components

- [statement] W3C recommends tightly wrapping each opposite-direction inline phrase, setting its base direction, and preserving nested directional structure. Directional isolation prevents the phrase from influencing surrounding text; unknown-direction content needs automatic direction determination and isolation. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/International/articles/inline-bidi-markup/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design

## How it works

- [statement] Treat text alignment and text direction as separate design decisions. Material Design distinguishes the placement of a text box from the flow within it and identifies text entry, cursor position, punctuation, phone numbers and URLs as common RTL rendering trouble spots. (low confidence) — https://m3.material.io/foundations/layout/bidirectionality-rtl · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] Do not reverse the digits inside a number when adapting an interface to RTL. Numeral shapes can still vary by locale; number localization and digit-order reversal are separate decisions. (medium confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/right-to-left · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://m2.material.io/design/usability/bidirectionality.html
- [statement] Validate the meaning and tone of localized content through user tasks, including when different markets share a language. Nielsen Norman Group recommends content testing with culturally diverse audiences and reviewing tone after translation. (low confidence) — https://www.nngroup.com/articles/why-international-usability-testing/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Check locale-specific date formats, currency placement, decimal and grouping separators, measurement units, address forms and phone validation. SimpleLocalize lists these as localization QA checks. (low confidence) — https://simplelocalize.io/blog/posts/ui-localization-best-practices/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] In Weblate issue 5340, a maintainer attributed an apparent Arabic punctuation displacement to stored character order and rendering context, and advised checking the consuming application. This historical support exchange illustrates why a JSON preview alone cannot establish correct bidi behavior. (low confidence) — https://github.com/WeblateOrg/weblate/issues/5340 · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] Test contraction as well as expansion, and inspect long unbreakable compounds. W3C notes that smaller translations can leave problematic whitespace and that compound words can fail to wrap where an English phrase wraps. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/International/articles/article-text-size/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The Material Design versions differ in stated scope: Material Design 2 describes linear time as mirrored in RTL, whereas Material Design 3 explicitly keeps Hebrew linear progress indicators LTR. Apply the version- and locale-specific guidance rather than treating the older generalization as universal. (low confidence) — https://m2.material.io/design/usability/bidirectionality.html · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://m3.material.io/foundations/layout/bidirectionality-rtl

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Treat a locale as more than a language: regional conventions affect dates, currencies, units and other interaction details. (medium confidence) — https://unicode-org.github.io/icu/userguide/locale/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://simplelocalize.io/blog/posts/ui-localization-best-practices/
- [statement] For RTL interfaces, mirror navigation order and directional icons, and align translated RTL text appropriately. Right-aligning text alone does not describe the required layout changes. (medium confidence) — https://m2.material.io/design/usability/bidirectionality.html · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/code-quality/coding-style/rtl_guidelines.html
- [statement] Preserve the reading direction of numbers and embedded LTR words such as URLs inside an RTL interface; do not reverse their characters with the surrounding layout. (medium confidence) — https://m2.material.io/design/usability/bidirectionality.html · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://www.w3.org/International/articles/inline-bidi-markup/
- [statement] Apply mirroring selectively: Mozilla excludes direction-neutral icons, product logos and video/audio controls; Material likewise excludes non-directional icons and media playback controls. (medium confidence) — https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/code-quality/coding-style/rtl_guidelines.html · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://m2.material.io/design/usability/bidirectionality.html
- [statement] Allow translated text to reflow and avoid tightly constrained fixed-width containers. Expansion depends on the string, and contraction can also disturb layouts; one universal expansion allowance is insufficient. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/International/articles/article-text-size/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] Validate actual script typography, including font coverage, accents, line height and mixed-script alignment. Character counts alone do not determine the space needed by translated text. (medium confidence) — https://www.w3.org/International/articles/article-text-size/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://www.w3.org/TR/alreq/, https://simplelocalize.io/blog/posts/ui-localization-best-practices/
- [statement] Test localized experiences with users in the target markets early and after launch. NN/g reports that domestic testing can miss culturally specific issues and features international users rely on. (low confidence) — https://www.nngroup.com/articles/why-international-usability-testing/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] Combine visual QA for each locale, manual RTL testing and native-speaker review; SimpleLocalize explicitly includes all three in its localization checklist. (low confidence) — https://simplelocalize.io/blog/posts/ui-localization-best-practices/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] Practitioner guidance differs on dates: Exadel recommends an international date format for RTL interfaces, while SimpleLocalize recommends local date formats. These are attributed recommendations, not evidence that one format suits every Arabic-speaking user. (low confidence) — https://exadel.com/news/localization-testing-tips-and-tricks-for-rtl-language-websites-and-apps · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://simplelocalize.io/blog/posts/ui-localization-best-practices/
- [statement] W3C distinguishes internationalization, which enables localization through product design and development, from localization, which adapts a product to the language, cultural and other requirements of a target locale. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/International/questions/qa-i18n · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] Localization extends beyond translating words: review number, date and time formats, currency, sorting, address and contact formats, and script readability; locale conventions can differ within the same language. (medium confidence) — https://www.w3.org/International/questions/qa-i18n · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://unicode-org.github.io/icu/userguide/locale/
- [statement] Mixed-direction inline phrases can misplace neutral punctuation or adjacent numbers and can reorder logically separate phrases. W3C identifies URLs, phone numbers, addresses and names as common examples that require attention. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/International/articles/inline-bidi-markup/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] Mirror back and forward navigation to preserve reading-order meaning in RTL interfaces. Preserve controls that indicate an actual physical direction or point to a specific onscreen area. (medium confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/right-to-left · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://m3.material.io/foundations/layout/bidirectionality-rtl
- [statement] Selective mirroring preserves meaning: Material Design keeps media playback controls and clockwise clock or circular-progress symbols unchanged; Apple also advises preserving logos, universal marks and real-world object icons unless the object communicates direction. (medium confidence) — https://m3.material.io/foundations/layout/bidirectionality-rtl · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/right-to-left
- [statement] Material Design 3 explicitly scopes mirroring by locale: graphs and charts retain LTR directionality for Persian and Urdu, while Hebrew timelines, media controls and linear progress indicators retain LTR directionality. (low confidence) — https://m3.material.io/foundations/layout/bidirectionality-rtl · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://m2.material.io/design/usability/bidirectionality.html
- [statement] Plan for translated text to change length. W3C recommends flexible layouts, reflow, avoiding small fixed-width containers, and keeping font size and line height adaptable. Its examples do not justify one universal expansion allowance for every string. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/International/articles/article-text-size/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] Character count alone does not predict translated layout size. W3C describes wider glyphs and greater line-height requirements in non-Latin scripts; typography review must include horizontal and vertical space. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/International/articles/article-text-size/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] For Arabic-script typography, verify cursive joining and diacritic positioning with the intended font. W3C describes letters joining their neighbors and multiple diacritics attaching to one base character using font-defined shapes or positions. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/TR/alreq/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] Validate with people in the intended market early. Nielsen Norman Group reports that international testing can expose language-switcher findability and other problems that domestic testing misses, and recommends testing before a new-market launch. (low confidence) — https://www.nngroup.com/articles/why-international-usability-testing/ · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design
- [statement] Include gestures in RTL interaction review. Material Design 3 says horizontal swipes and the side from which swipe actions are revealed should mirror their LTR counterparts. (low confidence) — https://m3.material.io/foundations/layout/bidirectionality-rtl · keywords: Internationalization, localization and RTL interaction design · also: https://m2.material.io/design/usability/bidirectionality.html
